assets.name: 像素·海边
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: square background-only image for a browser anime livestream domino game.
Primary request: an authentic Japanese anime 16-bit pixel art environment, composed as a classic handheld JRPG courtyard. Deliberate chunky square pixel clusters, stepped edges, selective dithering, restrained 32-color palette, crisp navy contour lines, flat 2-3 cel-shaded color ramps. Looks drawn on a 320x320 pixel grid enlarged with nearest neighbor. No smooth gradients, no blur, no clay/toy/rounded 3D rendering, no glossy AI illustration look.
Composition: square image. Camera looks slightly down onto ONE continuous flat ground plane. Environment scenery mostly in upper 40% and extreme side edges. The lower 60% must be a broad EMPTY walkable pale blue-grey ground all the way to all lower edges. Six rows of game dominoes will be overlaid at x 10%-90%, y 49%-88%; leave this entire region unobstructed, with quiet subtle perspective paving lines. No floating platform, no raised island, no framing border.
Palette: match a blue-haired navy-and-white anime whale maid: indigo, ocean blue, icy white, with small scene-specific accents. Balanced quiet ground to make the blue-haired character and pastel dominoes legible.
Constraints: background only. NO people, NO characters, NO animals, NO dominoes or bricks standing upright, NO UI, NO text, NO watermark.
Scene: a nostalgic seaside Japanese street corner in summer, white plaster houses with cobalt tiled roofs hugging the upper left and upper right, distant sparkling blue ocean and white pixel clouds in the upper center, compact blue hydrangeas at edges, a tiny whale-shaped weather vane on one roof. The street opens into a large empty pale blue limestone plaza in the foreground. Hand-authored anime game background, peaceful coastal air. Clear sunlight, sparse angular pixel shadows confined to edges.
